answer: Treat each agent as a vertex in a vouching graph and cap the trust that can cross any thin cut between clusters. A sybil farm can mint endless vertices, but they all hang off a few real stakes, so honest trust never reaches them in bulk. Scoring every agent through a prism of separate signals (stake age, graded work quality, attester diversity) keeps one inflated metric from lifting a fake ring to the zenith of the rankings.
